questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A candidate who gets 30% marks fails by 10 marks. Another candidate who gets 40% marks gets 15 marks more than passing marks. What are the passing marks?
questions.solution: Let total = T. 0.30T + 10 = 0.40T - 15 → 25 = 0.10T → T = 250. Passing = 0.30×250 + 10 = 85. Hmm, that doesn't match... Let me recalculate: 0.30T + 10 = pass marks. 0.40T - 15 = pass marks. So 0.30T + 10 = 0.40T - 15 → 25 = 0.10T → T = 250. Pass = 0.30(250)+10 = 85. Not matching options. This question seems poorly constructed.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Two articles are sold at ₹1200 each. One at 20% profit and other at 20% loss. What is the net result?
questions.solution: CP1 = 1200/1.20 = 1000, CP2 = 1200/0.80 = 1500. Total CP = 2500, Total SP = 2400. Loss = ₹100... Actually: loss% on whole = (20/100)² = 4%. 4% of 2500 = ₹100. But wait, let me recalculate: Net loss = 200²/100 = 400/100... Actually for equal SP with x% profit and x% loss: loss = x²/100 % = 400/100 = 4%. On average CP of 1250, loss = ₹50. Hmm, let me recheck: Total CP = 1000 + 1500 = 2500. Total SP = 2400. Loss = ₹100. Loss% = 100/2500 × 100 = 4%. The options should reflect ₹100 loss.
